description: Scores each text record as positive, negative, or neutral using VADER (Valence Aware Dictionary and sEntiment Reasoner). Lexicon-based — no model download, no API call, fast and explainable. Well-suited for short social and survey text: course evaluations, support tickets, open-ended responses, alumni comments. Returns a sentiment label and compound score (-1 to +1) per record.

text_column.description: Column containing the text to score

output_scores.description: Also output raw pos/neg/neu/compound scores per record (default false)
